claims.statement: For fixed d,r and polynomially small beta, a promised hidden partial-flag prefix can be acquired through exact chosen-pair comparisons with worst and expected charge A_(d,m)+O(n^2).
claims.quantifiers: Every bijective Q satisfying the degree and hidden constant-toggle flag promise; ideal fresh conditional random bits; probability UNKNOWN or wrong <= beta.
limitations: no query optimality or novelty claim

claims.statement: At most r witness period acquisitions are paid on every path, including semantically wrong paths and a final aborting dictionary.
limitations: post-drop-only checking would not justify the same cap

claims.statement: Full chosen-pair acquisition executed on cubic n8/r3, n12/r2 and n16/r2 fixtures, including coefficient/flag acquisition, full exact stabilizers and local rank/inverse.
limitations: full model requires all output bits degree <= d
finite PRNG runs are not ideal physical entropy evidence
larger rank/inverse execution checks are bounded

claims.statement: n32/r3 three-bit cubic prefix and exact prefix-fiber execution acquired using only the comparator with an arbitrary bijective demo suffix.
limitations: NO full-rank or inverse model for arbitrary suffix
latent h-vector preservation promise still supplied

limitations: query savings do not imply local bit-work or wall-time gain
